title: France Faces Twin Threats of Fiscal Strain and Sluggish Growth · 09 Sep
keywords: France, fiscal policy, public debt, budget, economic growth, inflation, Banque de France, INSEE, Eurostat, euro area, European Union, political paralysis, austerity, household finances, sovereign debt
notes: France's public finances are deteriorating at a moment when the economy is too weak to absorb the pressure, creating a compounding political and economic crisis for the government in Paris. Public debt is projected to exceed its 2020 peak in 2025, while growth for 2026 is forecast at just 0.7 percent. The combination is fuelling political paralysis and raising concerns that extend well beyond France's borders.
